clues: This small town is in Sonora, in Mexico. It sits near the border with Arizona.
This land is part of the Altar Desert. It is one of the driest and hottest parts of the great Sonoran Desert.
In the late 1990s, a big push began. The goal was to build this small city up for tourists.
Today, it is a key place for tourists in the north of Mexico. Few places in that part of the land draw more of them.
It stands on the north shore of the Sea of Cortez. A thin strip of land here joins a long peninsula to the rest of Mexico.
